briefdescription.para: Orchestrates a rolling update across all nodes of a ThemisDB cluster.

detaileddescription.para: The manager is transport-agnostic: actual per-node update execution, health checks, and rollbacks are injected as callbacks. This keeps the class independently testable and decoupled from any particular cluster transport (gRPC, Raft RPC, …).

listitem.para:
For each non-leader node (in the order supplied), then for each leader node: a. Mark DRAINING — emit progress. b. Invoke NodeUpdateFunc (→ APPLYING). c. Invoke NodeHealthCheckFunc (→ HEALTH_CHECK). d. On pass: REJOINING → COMPLETED. e. On fail (rollback_on_failure=true):
Invoke NodeRollbackFunc (if registered).
Mark ROLLED_BACK; abort update of remaining nodes.
